claim_status: prospective engineering targets; not observed improvements or source-derived laws
comparison: rerun baseline and candidate on the same hardware/interpreter or a newly preregistered equivalent platform, at identical semantic workload and protected outputs
execution: sequential isolated workers; same warmups, measured repetitions, seeds, input history, cache state, and completed work; retain every measured sample

primary_gates.rationale: A 15 percent margin defines a material improvement beyond small timing differences; it is an elected target, not a forecast.

metrics_scope.active_time: participant time excluding online assessor feed, measured on the six inherited matched workloads; report total and assessor time too
metrics_scope.live_allocation: Python allocations retained after restoring each of the two v4 checkpoints, with checkpoint text allocated before tracing and equivalent warm import state
metrics_scope.restore_peak: all traced transient allocations during that restoration; distinct from process maximum RSS
metrics_scope.compressed_checkpoint: deterministic gzip level 9, including the already-compressed baseline; raw bytes remain descriptive
metrics_scope.restore_time: untimed profiling pass is separate; report serialization, compression, restore, and offline reconstruction costs separately

new_capabilities: Compare a same-feature reference and optimized implementation under a prospectively frozen stage-specific workload; do not score additional functionality against an older engine that lacks it. General unique-history and dense-interaction workloads remain required by U13/U14.
failures: Any failed mandatory target keeps U13 efficiency acceptance open. Amended targets need a new version, preserved failure evidence, and evaluation cases not tuned against the former failure.
